evidence: Has the IPC label and modifies IPC socket listening, connection limit enforcement, and protocol interfaces across src/ipc/ and src/interfaces/ipc.h.
rationale: Fixes missing file descriptor accounting and enforces connection limits on incoming IPC sockets to prevent descriptor exhaustion and instability. As noted in the description and review discussion, IPC listening sockets previously lacked connection limits and startup FD reservation, which posed stability risks under heavy socket usage.
